entries.title: Psalms 12:1
segments: ¶<For the chief music-maker on the Sheminith. A Psalm. Of David.> Send help, Lord, for mercy has come to an end; there is no more faith among the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 12:2
segments: Everyone says false words to his neighbour: their tongues are smooth in their talk, and their hearts are full of deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 12:3
segments: The smooth lips and the tongue of pride will be cut off by the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 12:4
segments: They have said, With our tongues will we overcome; our lips are ours: who is lord over us?

entries.title: Psalms 12:5
segments: Because of the crushing of the poor and the weeping of those in need, now will I come to his help, says the Lord; I will give him the salvation which he is desiring.

entries.title: Psalms 12:6
segments: The words of the Lord are true words: like silver tested by fire and burned clean seven times.

entries.title: Psalms 12:7
segments: You will keep them, O Lord, you will keep them safe from this generation for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 12:8
segments: The sinners are walking on every side, and evil is honoured among the children of men.
